paragraphs: I am an Information and Communication Technology student at Eden University with a strong passion for software engineering, application development, cybersecurity, networking and emerging technologies.
I am interested in using technology to solve practical problems — building digital solutions that improve how individuals, students and businesses operate.

My journey combines academic learning, independent technical exploration, collaborative innovation and hands-on software development. Under my personal brand, timtiml, I keep looking for ways to turn ideas into working digital products.
My interests reach beyond programming into cybersecurity, network infrastructure, artificial intelligence, data engineering, cloud computing and technology entrepreneurship.
about.philosophy: I believe technology should solve real problems, and that the best way to learn is by building, experimenting and improving.

education.title: Bachelor of Science in Information and Communication Technology

career.text: I am particularly interested in combining software development and cybersecurity to create secure, useful and scalable technology solutions.
career.objective: I am an ICT student who actively develops practical solutions, explores emerging technologies and takes part in innovation — continuously building towards a career in software engineering and cybersecurity.

projects.title: Campus Crib
projects.desc: A student accommodation discovery platform that helps Eden University students find suitable off-campus accommodation. It addresses unreliable listings, inaccurate locations, high agent fees and the difficulty of reaching property owners.
features: Accommodation listings with descriptions and pricing
Controlled access to exact property locations

projects.title: Student Hub (SH)
projects.desc: An evolving student-focused financial management and productivity application that helps university students manage their personal finances.

projects.title: Retail Point of Sale Management System
projects.desc: A POS management system intended to support small retail businesses through digital sales processing, stock management, transaction recording and business reporting. Deployment is being planned.
features: Sales recording with automatic transaction entries

projects.title: AgriMobi AI
projects.desc: An agricultural technology innovation exploring how artificial intelligence and mobile applications can help address agricultural challenges in Zambia and Zimbabwe, with attention to prediction accuracy and reliability.

projects.title: Eden University Examination Eligibility System
projects.desc: A proposed academic administration platform that would automate examination eligibility verification using student information and payment records.
features: Institutional system integration, subject to authorised access
Proposed payment thresholds: CAT 1 at 50%, CAT 2 at 75%, final examinations at 100%

projects.title: Mobile Application Development
projects.desc: Ongoing learning towards building functional Android and iOS applications that address real-world challenges in education, business and everyday life.

projects.title: Cybersecurity Laboratories
projects.desc: Continuous hands-on practice in Linux security environments, network security, ethical hacking fundamentals, OSINT, Capture The Flag challenges, network reconnaissance and security testing fundamentals.
